title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.20259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prior

translated_title: 基于“人在回路”证据校准选择的大语言模型辅助治疗线判定规模化方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使以往依赖详尽人工审查的临床判定任务得以规模化。治疗线判定是肿瘤学队列构建中的主要瓶颈，是一个典型例子。治疗线边界必须依据细致且针对特定研究的定义，从纵向治疗史中推断得出，且需要对每个患者的每一次治疗方案转换进行判定。LLM能够大规模执行此类判定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史的复杂程度各不相同，模糊或非典型的治疗模式则依赖于专家的临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要为模型判定结果提供经过验证的支持，并具备识别需要人工审查病例的能力。本文提出了证据校准选择（ECS），这是一种用于规模化LLM辅助治疗线判定的“人在回路”框架。ECS从观察到的临床医生判定结果和先验（摘要在此处截断）中推导置信度……
tldr: 提出证据校准选择（ECS），一种“人在回路”框架，通过从临床医生判定结果中推导置信度来自动识别需要人工审查的病例，从而实现大语言模型辅助治疗线判定的规模化应用。
en_tdlr: We propose evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework that derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications to automatically identify cases warranting manual review, enabling the scaling of LLM-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication.
